{{Main|1991 ATP Tour}}
The '''1991 ATP Championship Series, Single Week''' was a series of [[tennis]] tournament that was part of the [[1991 ATP Tour]], the elite tour for professional [[men]]'s tennis organised by the [[Association of Tennis Professionals]]. It formed the tier below the [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] tournaments.
{{TOC limit|3}}
